title: Project + launcher menu (click = terminal, hover = grouped launcher)
body: Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-launcher-menu-design.md. Both + buttons (project titlebar, panel project row): click spawns default-shell terminal; hover opens grouped menu (Agents / Shells / Project tools / New project). Key files: src/wm.rs (hover_menu, header +, Act::AddTerm/AddTermPath, apply_add_term_path), src/panel.rs (row +), src/landing.rs (SessionKind), src/keymap.rs (chord hints). New: src/launcher.rs.
